mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.summary, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price, p.stock, p.status, c.name AS categoryName, pc.name AS topCategoryName FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND p.category_id IN
#{cid}
AND LOCATE(#{q.keyword}, p.name) > 0
ORDER BY
p.price ASC, p.id ASC
p.price DESC, p.id ASC
p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT * FROM product WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM product WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE product SET category_id = #{p.categoryId}, name = #{p.name}, summary = #{p.summary}, description = #{p.description}, cover_image = #{p.coverImage}, price = #{p.price}, sort_order = #{p.sortOrder}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{p.id} AND version = #{p.version}
